mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and stimulates risk-taking, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below the 25th percentile of its historical range.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in the labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) triggers Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1200 thousand units) reduces consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals economic contraction, reducing business investment and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A recent acceleration in inflation above 3.5% YoY (CPIAUCSL) increases market volatility and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS above the 75th percentile) indicate robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above the 75th percentile of its historical range.
